question: Re-verification of the live Middlesex County MA permit guide (#213, published 2026-08-16) for the permit records database. Facts read 2026-11-17 in the in-app browser.
verdictConfirmed: Only one city was checked. Cambridge's Inspectional Services Department takes permit applications through an OpenGov portal and publishes building-permit datasets on its open data portal. The guide's county-wide claims (town halls, street files) were not checked; a state source saying each municipality issues its own permits was not found in this pass.

facts.claim: Cambridge's Inspectional Services Department handles building, electric and plumbing permits; its page links Online Permitting to the city's OpenGov portal.
facts.quote: Inspectional Services - City of Cambridge, Massachusetts ... Building / Electric / Plumbing Permits ... Online Permitting ... click here -> https://cambridgema.portal.opengov.com/

facts.claim: The Cambridge OpenGov portal (City of Cambridge Permitting and Licensing System) is for applying for services; its public page offers no record search, only 'Your Records' and 'Claim a Record' after login.
facts.quote: City of Cambridge Permitting and Licensing System Access service information and apply online – all from here. ... Your Records ... Claim a Record

facts.claim: Cambridge's open data portal publishes building-permit datasets from Inspectional Services, including 'Building Permits: Addition/Alteration' (updated daily; only completed applications are listed; about 14.5K rows on 2026-11-17), 'Building Permits: New Construction', roof, siding and mechanical permits, and 'Housing Permits 1996 - Present'.
facts.quote: Data Provided by City of Cambridge Inspectional Services Department ... Limitations Only completed applications are listed in this dataset. ... Estimated Update Frequency Daily ... Rows 14.5K

cut: Guide: permits are held by each of the county's cities and towns, with physical 'street files' at town hall -- not checked against a state or town source in this pass.
Guide: other towns' online permitting portals -- not checked.
Cambridge: the datasets do not state a start year; no address was searched in them; no older-records route was found on the permit FAQ.

blockedSources.result: HTTP 404 (a URL we guessed; not a real page). mass.gov search returned no readable results to our browser, 2026-11-17.
